name: Coming of Age
summary: In Thendal Village, young Skyborne begin the rite that welcomes them into service to the shen'dorei. Ailee Farheart leads them to Rorian the Dayseeker, who gives each initiate an ancestral relic and hears their pledge to aid their people.

sections.title: A Rite of Passage
sections.body: Ailee Farheart guides young Skyborne from Thendal Village toward adulthood. They travel just west to the greatfather tree, where the village elder waits. For the shen'dorei, the rite marks a passage into adulthood and a pledge to serve their community. Local troubles are rising.

sections.title: The Ancestral Relic
sections.body: At the entrance to the greatfather tree, Rorian the Dayseeker leads the ceremony. He gives each initiate an ancestral relic, an heirloom passed through generations of shen'dorei. The relic is a token of the winds of home. It stays with its bearer until their ashes are scattered to the breeze.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Coming of Age ceremony?
faq.answer: The ceremony marks young Skyborne's passage into adulthood, welcomes them into service for the shen'dorei, and grants them an ancestral heirloom.

aliases: where does coming of age start
faq.answer: Ailee Farheart welcomes you in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle and guides you to meet the village leadership.

faq.q: Who do you report to for the ritual?
faq.answer: Rorian the Dayseeker, leader of Thendal Village, waits at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of the settlement.

faq.q: What relic is bestowed during the ceremony?
faq.answer: Rorian gives you an inherited relic carried through generations of shen'dorei. Tradition says it stays with you until death, then passes to the next generation.

faq.q: What does 'shen'dorei' mean in this context?
faq.answer: Rorian uses 'shen'dorei' to refer to the Skyborne, recalling their complex history, shared trials, and enduring identity on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Where does your journey lead immediately after this?
aliases: next steps after coming of age
faq.answer: After your rite of passage, Rorian directs you to local matters threatening the island, beginning with Harmony in Balance and Infestation Investigation.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you enter adulthood bearing a sacred family heirloom wherever the winds carry you.
